user.title: NR Backup NAS Sync
user.description: Native Home Assistant backup destination using your existing Synology DSM connection. Select this agent in Settings > System > Backups after setup. Use an existing dedicated FileStation folder.

data_description.site_name: Stable site identity. Recreating the entry changes the archive namespace; preserve the entry for existing backups.
data_description.remote_base_dir: Absolute FileStation path, for example /Backups/sandbox. Never use /volumeN or a folder shared with another environment.
data_description.retention_count: Applied by this integration after a verified upload. Legacy backups are preserved. Retention errors are reported separately.

error.invalid_site_name: Site name must not be empty.
